concept.hr: Tri načina da više korisnika dijeli jedan kanal
concept.en: Three ways to share one channel

summary.hr: Kanali po frekvenciji, slotovi u vremenu ili kodovi istodobno: dodaj korisnike i gledaj gdje sustav odbija, gdje rasipa, a gdje se sudara.
summary.en: Channels in frequency, slots in time or codes at once: add users and see where each scheme refuses, wastes or collides.

what.en: The rules of FDMA, TDMA and CDMA and the examples (text, summarised and adapted; 50ohm.de, section vielfachzugriff)

changes.hr: Odjeljak vielfachzugriff (hrvatski prijevod) sažet u pravila modela, opis i objašnjenje; brojevi, kapaciteti i čipovi CDMA-a su dodani; ništa nije preuzeto doslovno
changes.en: The section vielfachzugriff (Croatian translation) summarised into the model's rules, the captions and the explanation; the numbers, the capacities and the CDMA chips are added; nothing is copied verbatim
